meetings.title: Customer Success Retrospective
meetings.summary_text: The Customer Success retrospective reviewed the last quarter, covering what went well, what did not, and what to change. The team agreed to reach out to customers at forty-five days of inactivity, build an inactivity report, and create a one-page handover template with the sales team. Owners were assigned for the report, the call script, the handover template draft, the sales meeting, the follow-up retrospective, and a celebration of the improved satisfaction score.

decisions.text: Customers will be contacted before they reach sixty days of inactivity, at forty-five days.

meetings.title: Security Incident Debrief
meetings.summary_text: The debrief reviewed last week's Cobalt Reef phishing drill, which sent a simulated email to 400 staff: 61 clicked the link and 23 entered credentials, an improvement on the previous drill but still too many. Ninety people reported the message, with the fastest report within four minutes, and those who clicked were mostly on mobile devices where the sender address is harder to see. The group agreed on follow-up actions: testing a mobile-visible banner on external emails, a reminder on reporting suspicious emails, reporting results to the executive team, and scheduling the next drill.

decisions.text: The next phishing drill will be planned for the middle of next quarter.

The fastest report of the simulated email came within four minutes.

meetings.title: Sustainability Working Group
meetings.summary_text: The first meeting of the sustainability working group aimed to agree on single-use cups, water refill stations and electronic waste handling. The group agreed to remove single-use cups from all office kitchens on 1 March 2027, with reception keeping reusable cups for visitors. Owen will take forward refill stations on every floor, with installation targeted for the end of January, and Grace proposed a quarterly electronic waste collection day starting 14 February. Daniel will run a four-week waste audit to measure current waste so that progress can be shown later, reporting back at the next meeting.
